title: Coventry students take work experience campaign to Westminster
summary: Coventry pupils took their call for better work experience opportunities to Parliament earlier this week, meeting government ministers face to face.

title: Funding boost for Coventry’s Cultural and Creative Sector
summary: Eight cultural and creative organisations in Coventry have been awarded a share of £247,500 through the Coventry Culture & Creative Capital Grants programme.

title: New roving camera to help tackle fly-tipping
summary: The Council has introduced a new roving CCTV camera to help further tackle fly-tipping across the city.

title: Available MenB vaccines for young people
summary: Local pharmacies are playing an important role in helping protect residents as part of a vaccination programme across the city.

title: Big Wheel and Christmas Market bringing festive atmosphere to city centre
summary: The towering, big wheel and a cosy Christmas market will return to Broadgate next week, bringing a magical festive atmosphere to the city centre.

title: Preparing for adulthood transition event.
summary: If you are someone who is heading into adulthood, finishing school or college or even finishing education entirely and you have a care need, we want you to know there is support available.
